description: Production netd acquires a DHCPv4 lease through E1000 and keeps address ownership synchronized with renewal, rebinding, NAK and replacement.

required.claim: the sealed catalog started the production service with a NIC capability
netd published a lease only after matching OFFER and ACK
netd accepted a unicast renewal without losing address ownership
netd invalidated the lease when the server NAKed a rebind
netd installed a new address after the old lease was invalidated

forbidden.why: private boot smoke performs intentional faults before supervisor launch
